verdicts.typography: Excellent typographic hierarchy and Swiss-style discipline. Mono uppercase labels are perfectly applied. One minor nitpick: the line-height in the body copy (d1-hero, d6-verdict) feels slightly loose for a strict report format, creating slightly more vertical drift than optimal.
verdicts.color: Flawless execution of the minimalist palette. Single restrained red accent used consistently for interactive states, highlights, and emphasis. Near-black on white provides excellent contrast. No off-brand colors or visual noise detected.
verdicts.layout: Strong grid alignment and generous whitespace rhythm. The max-w container is consistent. One observable defect: in d4-analysis, the bottom-right 'THE RESULT' card has a visible red left-border that breaks the hairline border consistency of the surrounding grid cells, creating a minor alignment/visual weight inconsistency.
verdicts.components: High-quality component design. The matrix table is legible with clear iconography, and the accordion list provides good affordances. One defect: the matrix table (d3-matrix) lacks a sticky first column or header indication in this view, and the red highlight column, while effective, slightly dominates the minimalist aesthetic more than a subtle background tint would.
verdicts.responsive: Flawless execution across mobile and dark-mode. Mobile layout maintains integrity at 390px with no overflow or clipped text; the wide matrix table handles horizontal scrolling correctly with a sticky first column for context. Dark mode demonstrates consistent palette usage, high contrast ratios, and proper component visibility.

typography: Reduce body copy line-height from ~1.7 to ~1.5-1.6 to tighten vertical rhythm and match the stringent report aesthetic.
layout: Remove or standardize the red left-border on the 'THE RESULT' card in the analysis grid (d4) to maintain strict hairline border consistency across all grid cells.
components: Consider adding position: sticky to the first column of the matrix table for improved usability during horizontal scrolling; optionally reduce the opacity/saturation of the final column's red background to better adhere to the 'restrained' accent requirement.
